rows.copy: Reviews source-backed ad spend, leads and returns when those measurements are available. Automatic ROAS, cost-per-lead and attribution analysis is not available in Business Review yet; a listed ad provider does not prove a connection or a return.
rows.name: Ad Spend Efficiency Read

rows.copy: Flags client risk only when permitted activity or service-delivery evidence supports it. Current client and lifecycle totals do not establish churn risk. Source-backed client churn detection is not available in Business Review yet.
rows.name: Churn Signal Detection

rows.copy: Compares retention and expansion only from authoritative acquisition-cohort evidence. Current client totals cannot reconstruct cohort history. Cohort comparisons are not available in Business Review yet.
rows.name: Cohort Analysis Read

rows.copy: PAIGE can review recorded form intake, submissions linked to an opportunity, and current pipeline evidence when permitted. Visitor conversion, causal attribution and historical stage-to-stage drop-off diagnosis are not available in Business Review yet.
rows.name: Conversion Funnel Diagnosis

rows.copy: Interprets authorized email, content and audience measurements when their sources provide them. Source-backed channel engagement is not available in Business Review yet. A contact count or listed connection is not evidence of engagement.
rows.name: Engagement Read

rows.copy: PAIGE can explain available business evidence for the last 30 days and identify missing information. Filing a monthly review document for approval and later retrieval remains unverified. A Chat answer is not a filed document or permission to send it.
rows.name: Monthly Business Review Draft

rows.copy: PAIGE can discuss the current quarter using available business evidence and its limitations. Filing a quarterly narrative for approval and later retrieval remains unverified. No unsupported financial history, forecast or delivery is promised.
rows.name: Quarterly Narrative Draft

rows.copy: PAIGE can compare recorded receipts where complete, compatible source periods exist, with currencies kept separate. Recorded receipts are not recognized revenue, MRR, ARR, profit or bank cash. Full revenue-series analysis requires authoritative revenue evidence.
rows.name: Revenue Trend Read

rows.copy: Ask PAIGE for a sourced weekly review of available sales, collections, client, operations, recorded form intake and Strategic Play evidence. Missing information stays explicit and recommendations need supporting evidence. This is a read-only review; automatic scheduling, sends and business actions are not included.
rows.name: Weekly Business Review
